benchmark.formula: y = offset + amplitude * sin(angular_frequency * x + phase)
benchmark.name: Sin/Cos synthetic function regression

regimes.extrapolation_stress: Context lies in [-1, 1]; Query lies outside it; not used for checkpoint selection
regimes.gap_interpolation: Context lies outside [-0.6, 0.6]; Query is the central missing gap
regimes.interpolation: domain endpoints are Context; all Query points lie inside their hull

interpretation_notes: All reported Gaussian intervals are pointwise, not simultaneous function bands.
The extrapolation stress test also changes Context layout and is not a heart-rate future model.
The family-aware Sin/Cos regression baseline is omitted for Context=3 because frequency is underidentified.
Test banks are evaluated only after selecting and reloading the best validation checkpoint.

parameter_banks.overlap_check: all exact parameter tuples are disjoint

training.selection_metric: mean ID validation NLL over interpolation regimes
